name: auto-factory
description: Turns a Jira issue (or a local task) into a reviewed pull request (/auto-factory:code): intake, spec with test data, build, gate with checks, UI checks (web pages, and mobile apps on virtual phones) and security scans, verified reviews, approver, self-learning. Reviews a colleague's merge request against its ticket (/auto-factory:review). Project-, stack- and language-agnostic; each project gets its own factory repository, and the project is only touched through pull requests.
